description: This is a PHP source file defining the PerformanceTrackerDao class. It handles database operations related to performance tracking, including retrieval, creation, update, deletion of performance tracker entities, as well as managing their reviewers and related filters within a Human Resource Management System.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for PerformanceTracker entity, providing methods to interact with performance tracking data, manage reviewers, and perform complex queries with filtering, sorting, and transactional integrity.

methods.name: getPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Retrieves a PerformanceTracker entity by its ID if it exists and is active.

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceTrackerIds
methods.description: Fetches a list of performance tracker IDs from a given list of IDs, filtering out deleted or inactive entries.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackList
methods.description: Returns a list of PerformanceTracker objects based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerCount
methods.description: Returns the count of PerformanceTracker records matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: savePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Persists a PerformanceTracker entity along with its reviewers within a transaction.

methods.name: updatePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Updates an existing PerformanceTracker and synchronizes its list of reviewers.

methods.name: getReviewerListByTrackerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviewers associated with a specific performance tracker.

methods.name: deletePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Marks performance trackers as deleted based on their IDs.

methods.name: getTrackerIdsByReviewerId
methods.description: Gets all tracker IDs associated with a specific reviewer.

methods.name: getTrackerIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves tracker IDs associated with a specific employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeIdsByReviewerId
methods.description: Retrieves employee numbers for trackers reviewed by a specific reviewer.

methods.name: isTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Checks if a given employee number is a reviewer for any active performance tracker.

methods.name: isTrackerOwnerEditable
methods.description: Determines if a tracker is editable based on the presence of non-deleted logs.
